task.name: inject-governance
task.description: Hook that runs at the start and end of every D-AIDLC workflow step to ensure governance controls are applied automatically.

check.action: Verify current stage is valid for this workflow
Log step start to audit trail: - Timestamp: current ISO 8601 - Phase: current phase - Stage: current stage - Action: "Step {{step_number}} started: {{step_goal}}" - Agent: {{agent_name}}
Log step start to audit trail (minimal entry)

on-step-end.action: Log step completion to audit trail

check.action: Run content validation on any files created in this step
If validation fails, flag issues but allow continuation (standard)
If content validation fails, BLOCK progression until issues fixed
Create question file if any ambiguity detected

on-stage-transition.action: Run validate-stage workflow for current stage
If validation fails, present options: 1. Fix and re-validate 2. Override (audit logged) 3. Return to current stage
Log transition decision to audit trail

check.action: NEVER ask questions directly in chat
Notify user: "Questions file created at [path]. Please answer and save."
Create question file for complex/multi-part questions
Simple yes/no clarifications may be asked in chat
Questions asked in chat (no file requirement)
